before.requirement: Explicitly supply all 16 hash-salt bytes, including a nonzero first key half, before parsing.
before.reason: The before source stores only an unsigned-long salt and copies zero into the first SipHash key half. The reconstructed preimage has no XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes definition in xmlparse.c.

source_evidence.quote: Verified preimage file expat/lib/xmlparse.c has no function definition named XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes. The entire after definition consists of added lines. This establishes absence in this file only; other implementations or equivalent paths must still be considered.

after.requirement: Explicitly supply all 16 hash-salt bytes, including a nonzero first key half, to a fresh parser before parsing.
after.reason: The new public setter copies caller-supplied 16-byte entropy before parsing. The old harness calls only XML_SetHashSalt, whose after implementation fixes the first key half to zero.

source_evidence.quote:
XMLPARSEAPI(XML_Bool)
XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes(XML_Parser parser, const uint8_t entropy[16]);

claims.reason: The tuple is the same explicit 16-byte pre-parse operation on both sides. It was unsupported before and is supported but unreachable through the fixed harness after; the prior unsigned-long limitation is not labeled a preexisting blocker for a capability that did not yet exist.
